title: Listing
description: A residential real-estate listing scraped from a Catalan portal.

id.description: Stable Bruixola listing ID. SHA1 of (platform + platform_id) hex first 12.

platform_id.description: Platform-internal listing ID (used for dedup + re-fetch).

url.description: Canonical listing URL on the source platform.

town.description: Town/city name (Catalan canonical form, e.g. 'Reus', 'l'Hospitalet de Llobregat').

condition_label.description: Derived from listing description regex (see derive.py).

okupa_risk.description: Derived from text + source heuristics (see derive.py).

in_zona_tensionada.description: True if address falls within a Catalonia zona tensionada per Llei 12/2023.

rent_index_ceiling_eur_m2_mo.description: Monthly rent ceiling per m² from the SERPAVI índex de referència. Null if unit is not in a zona tensionada or index data is unavailable.

gross_yield_pct_p25.description: P25 of estimated annual gross yield.

gross_yield_pct_p50.description: P50 (median) of estimated annual gross yield.

gross_yield_pct_p75.description: P75 of estimated annual gross yield.

gross_yield_pct_legal_max.description: Maximum legally achievable annual gross yield given the zona tensionada ceiling. Null if not in a zona tensionada.

yield_formula_version.description: Stamped on every yield calc to detect formula drift.

hut_license_id.description: Habitatge d'Ús Turístic license ID if present in the Generalitat registry.

scraped_at.description: When this row was last refreshed by the scraper pipeline.

first_seen_at.description: When this listing first appeared in our data.

removed_at.description: Set when the listing disappears from source (sold/withdrawn).
